text: わたしは　せいめい　はんだんし　いうなれば　なまえの　うらないです　はい　あなたの　ポケモンの　ニックネーム　うらなって　あげるよ
note: せいめいはんだん (seimei handan) is a real Japanese kind of fortune-telling that judges a person's name, traditionally by counting the strokes of its kanji. The English "Name Rater" drops the fortune-telling idea.
claim: Seimei handan is a Japanese form of fortune-telling based on the number of strokes in the kanji of a person's name.

check.quote: in Japan, onomancy is known as 姓名判断 (Japanese: seimei handan). ... the most popular is based on the character strokes in the subject's written name
